articles.text: 教師: 今晩、飲みに行きませんか。 (Kyoushi: Konban nomi ni ikimasen ka?)
INSTRUCTOR: Shall we go out for a drink tonight?
学生: いいですね。行きましょう。 (Gakusei: Ii desu ne. Ikimashoo.) [accepting] / 今日はちょっと… (Kyoo wa chotto...) [declining]
STUDENT: That sounds good. Let's go. [accepting] / Today is (not so good for me)... [declining]
